name: BBGC Summer Program
description_short: The Boys & Girls Club of Bristol's summer day program for children entering grades 1 to 5, held at the main club on West Street from 7:30 am to 5:30 pm. Days mix hands on activities, themed events and spirit days, walks to the Rockwell Park pool and weekly field trips.
refund_policy_summary: The $50 registration fee and $50 weekly deposits are not refundable. Dropping a week needs a change of contract form at least one week ahead, or 50% of that week's tuition is charged.
swim_waterfront_notes: Groups walk to the Rockwell Park pool to swim on set days.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 registration closed. Grades are the grade entering in the fall. Hours 7:30 am to 5:30 pm, Monday to Friday. $250 a week, plus a $50 registration fee; a $50 weekly deposit counts toward tuition. 5% military and sibling discounts. Financial help through Care4Kids and other sources.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Summer Informational Packet: summer program held at the main club, 255 West St., Bristol, CT 06010, 7:30 am to 5:30 pm. Breakfast and lunch from Bristol Public Schools are offered to every child in the program who signs up for them; children may also bring lunch. Field trips run Wednesdays from July 8 to August 12; pool days at Rockwell Park.
